claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: NAN-190 is a 5-HT1A antagonist/alpha1-adrenergic ligand that, at 2.5 uM over 5 days, most plausibly produces cationic amphiphilic lysosomal stress/cytotoxicity rather than receptor-mediated killing, since its annotated GPCR targets are not cytotoxic and no class-specific killing pattern is expected.
